flags: IDT Corporation's Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable on October 14, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 5, 2026.

IDT Telecom entered into an amendment to its revolving credit agreement with TD Bank, N.A., increasing seasonal credit to $50.0 million (May and December), adding three corporate guarantors, and extending the maturity date to July 15, 2029.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Segment Reporting section)
business_model.claim: IDT operates four reportable segments: NRS, Fintech, net2phone, and Traditional Communications.
quotes: We have four reportable business segments: (1) NRS; (2) Fintech; (3) net2phone; and (4) Traditional Communications.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Business Overview)
business_model.claim: NRS sells a POS terminal-based platform, payment processing, SaaS, and retail media advertising to independent retailers (convenience stores, bodegas, liquor stores, small-format grocery, tobacco stores) in the US and Canada.
quotes: Operates a leading point-of-sale, or POS, terminal-based platform for independent retailers in the United States and Canada including convenience stores, bodegas, liquor stores, small-format grocery stores, and tobacco stores.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, NRS Overview)
business_model.claim: Recurring services (merchant services, SaaS subscriptions, advertising and data licensing) generated approximately 95% of NRS revenue in fiscal 2026.
quotes: Recurring services – Merchant Services, terminal-based software subscriptions, and advertising and data licensing – generated approximately 95% of NRS' revenue in fiscal 2026.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (MD&A, NRS Segment) and P4 (8-K earnings release)
business_model.claim: NRS revenue grew 23.8% to $159.4 million in fiscal 2026, driven by network expansion, payment processing penetration, card adoption, and higher SaaS revenue per terminal.
quotes: Revenues increased in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025 driven primarily by continued growth in recurring revenue, reflecting the expansion of NRS' retailer network, increased penetration of payment processing services, improved payment processing economics, retail customers' increasing use of credit/debit cards rather than cash at NRS locations, and increased software revenue per terminal as retailers increasingly adopted premium software as a service (SaaS) features and functionalities.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1) and P4 (8-K earnings release table)
business_model.claim: As of July 31, 2026, the NRS network included approximately 40,400 active POS terminals in approximately 35,000 retail stores and 29,400 payment processing accounts.
quotes: As of July 31, 2026, the NRS POS network included approximately 40,400 active terminals operating in approximately 35,000 independent retail stores, an increase from approximately 37,200 active terminals a year earlier.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Business Overview)
business_model.claim: BOSS Money provides international and domestic money transfers to US customers, with destinations in approximately 50 countries across Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa, Europe, and Asia.
quotes: BOSS Money makes it easy and convenient to share funds and other resources with friends and family in approximately 50 destination countries in Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa, Europe, and Asia, as well as within the United States.

business_model.claim: Fintech segment revenue grew 13.8% to $176.0 million in fiscal 2026, driven by higher digital transaction volumes and foreign currency exchange revenues, mainly to Guatemala and Mexico.
quotes: Revenues increased in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025 driven by higher digital transaction volumes initiated on the BOSS Money and BOSS Revolution Calling apps in addition to higher foreign currency exchange revenues to select regions, mainly Guatemala and Mexico.

business_model.basis: stated in P4 (8-K earnings release, BOSS Money section)
business_model.claim: Digital transaction volume reached 88.1% of total BOSS Money transactions in 4Q26, accelerated by a federal tax on retail remittance transactions effective January 1, 2026.
quotes: Digital transaction volume as a percentage of total transactions increased to 88.1% in 4Q26, reflecting BOSS Money's focused investments in digital customer acquisition programs and the industry-wide acceleration of the ongoing migration of consumers to digital channels from retail in the wake of a federal tax on remittances imposed on retail transactions beginning on January 1, 2026.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1) and P3 (MD&A, net2phone Segment)
business_model.claim: net2phone sells UCaaS, CCaaS, AI Agent, and Coach (workforce intelligence) solutions to businesses, with subscription revenue of $94.9 million in fiscal 2026.
quotes: Provides businesses with workflow and communications solutions, many of which are powered by AI, that analyze, inform, and manage business processes for enhanced productivity.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Segment Reporting)
business_model.claim: The Traditional Communications segment (IDT Digital Payments, BOSS Revolution, IDT Global) generated $865.9 million in fiscal 2026 revenue, or 66.7% of total consolidated revenue.
quotes: The Traditional Communications segment, which contributed revenue of $865.9 million in fiscal 2026 and $860.2 million in fiscal 2025 (66.7% and 69.8% of our total revenues, respectively) comprises IDT Digital Payments, BOSS Revolution, and IDT Global, as well as other small businesses and offerings including early-stage business initiatives and mature businesses in harvest mode.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Business Overview)
business_model.claim: IDT Global provides wholesale international voice and SMS termination to telecoms worldwide, while BOSS Revolution provides international long-distance calling at rates below mobile network operators to immigrant communities in the US and Canada.
quotes: Provides wholesale international voice and SMS termination and outsourced traffic management solutions to telecoms worldwide.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (MD&A, percentage-of-revenue table) and F2 (income statement: gross profit $496,788 on revenues $1,297,960)
business_model.claim: Consolidated gross margin improved to 38.3% in fiscal 2026 from 36.2% in fiscal 2025, as direct cost of revenues declined from 63.8% to 61.7% of revenue.
quotes: Direct costs of revenues increased at a slower rate than revenue, contributing to an increase in gross margin.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (MD&A, NRS Segment table and commentary)
business_model.claim: NRS gross margin was 92.0% in fiscal 2026, up 130 bps from 90.7% in fiscal 2025, reflecting operating leverage in the platform model.
quotes: NRS' income from operations grew faster than its revenue, reflecting the operating leverage inherent in the NRS platform.

business_model.basis: stated in P4 (8-K earnings release, BOSS Money/Fintech section)
business_model.claim: Fintech gross margin expanded 360 bps to 62.3% in fiscal 2026, driven by the rotation from lower-margin retail to higher-margin digital transactions and more favorable payout terms.
quotes: The Fintech segment's year-over-year increases in gross profit margin, 650 bps in 4Q26 and 360 bps in FY 2026, primarily reflected the continuing rotation in the transaction mix to higher margin digital transactions from lower margin retail transactions, supplemented by the impact of increased average send amounts and continuous efforts to negotiate more favorable payout terms.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Strategy section)
business_model.claim: IDT's customer base comprises approximately 1.8 million unique monthly users, predominantly first- and second-generation immigrants in the US, served through approximately 35,000 NRS retail locations and approximately 18,000 BOSS retail agents.
quotes: Our customer base of approximately 1.8 million unique monthly users, predominantly first and second-generation immigrants within the U.S.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Strategy section)
business_model.claim: IDT's growth businesses (NRS, BOSS Money, net2phone) were developed organically and financed with cash flows from mature businesses, avoiding debt financing and dilutive capital raises.
quotes: The development of each of our current high-margin growth businesses – NRS, BOSS Money, and net2phone - has been principally organic and financed with the cash flows generated by our mature businesses. Consequently, we have avoided debt financing and dilutive capital raises.

quotes: On August 13, 2026, IDT Telecom, Inc. (“IDT Telecom”), a subsidiary of IDT Corporation (the “Company”), entered into an amendment (the “Amendment”) to its revolving credit agreement with TD Bank, N.A. (the “Bank”).
